SYNTHETIC TEST FIXTURE - NOT A REAL STATUTE
THE EXAMPLE CRIMINAL PROCEDURE ACT, 2030
ACT NO. 99 OF 2030
BE IT ENACTED by the Example Legislature as follows:
1. Short title. This Act may be called the Example Criminal Procedure Act, 2030.
2. Bail in non-serious offences. A person accused of a non-serious offence shall be released on bail unless the court records reasons for refusal.
3. Default bail. Where the charge sheet is not filed within sixty days of arrest, the accused shall be entitled to be released on bail.
